description: This file defines a Spring configuration class for a batch job that applies holidays to loans. It sets up a job and a step, wiring in dependencies and defining beans for executing the holiday application process within a batch job framework.

classes.name: ApplyHolidaysToLoansConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for a batch job and its step to apply holidays to loans.

methods.name: applyHolidaysToLoansStep
methods.description: Creates a Step bean for executing the tasklet that applies holidays to loans.

methods.name: applyHolidaysToLoansJob
methods.description: Creates a Job bean that orchestrates the execution of the step with a unique run ID.
